question_text:
Explain the principles of classical political economy, including the ideas of
Adam Smith.

Explain the concept of post-war Keynesian consensus. Describe how his
vision about ‘self-regulating markets in times of crisis’ differs from that of
the classical political economists.

Describe the challenges faced by the Latin American countries in the
aftermath of their Independence.

Explain the emergence of three major Bretton Wood institutions in the
aftermath of the 2nd World War.

Account for the emergence of the third world and explain the common
characteristics of the third world countries.

What is ‘declining terms of trade syndrome’? Explain the theory with any
example.

How did 'managed capitalism' emerge and influence the development thinking after
World War II?
What role did classical political economists attribute to the ‘state’?
What is the context in which 'structural adjustment' emerged in the 1980s?

What is the central argument of post-development theory with regard to the concept
of development?

In what ways did Keynesian economics shape the development strategies of
first-world countries in the post-war era?

What is the difference between positive and negative rights? Explain with examples
from contemporary scenarios.

Explain the purpose and role of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) established
during the Bretton Woods Conference and also explain its shortcomings.

What were the significance and shortcomings of GATT (General Agreement on
Tariffs and Trade) in promoting international trade?
Explain the common characteristics of the "third world" countries?

What economic strategy did Latin American countries adopt during the Depression
and post-war periods?

How did the ‘declining terms of trade syndrome’ thesis emerge? What were the trade
disadvantages explained in this thesis?
What was the 'silver lining' mentioned in the laissez-faire capitalism model?

Explain the Keynesian vision of a smoothly running capitalist economy.
Explain how and why did it differed from that of the other classical
political economists with the example of a slow economy during recession
(10 M).

Discuss the background in which Modernization theory by W.W. Rostow
was proposed. Explain the 5 stages of development given in the theory
(10M).

What is dependency theory? Discuss the strategies given by dependency
theorists to counter the western models of development which advocate
trade between the third world and the first world (10M).

Explain the concept of Import Substitution Industrialization (ISI). Explain
two middle eastern country case studies of ISI experimentation for their
development? (10M).

Discuss the concept of “Development” as mentioned by various schools of
thought spanning the conventional ideological spectrum, including the left,
the right and the centre. What are the defining factors that differentiate
their positions regarding what constitutes ‘Development’(10M)?

Discuss the cases of Ghana, and Kenya and their experimentation with ISI.
Compare both cases and conclude as to which one of them succeeded in
achieving development (10M).

Compare all the Latin American cases of ISI experimentation given in the
reader, rearrange them in descending order of preference from the most
problematic to the least. Justify your order of preference with proper
reasoning (10M).

Explain the Indian development trajectory in the aftermath of
independence in 1947. Highlight the significant events that made India a
role model for the entire South Asia (10M).

You are part of a national level committee set up by the PMO for sharing policy
recommendations regarding Development planning for your country. Explain your plan
of action for the upcoming 5 years using the following two ideological vantage points:
Explain with examples from the reader-

subparts.label: a
subparts.text:
Which theoretical and practical factors made statist development strategies
appealing to third-world countries in the aftermath of the second world war.

subparts.label: b
subparts.text:
Which third world countries following ISI model experienced success and why?
Give 5 examples with sufficient explanation.

Comprehensively explain the context in which the following observations are made by
the author? Use analytical style wherever necessary.

subparts.label: a
subparts.text: “The first world had sneezed; much of the third world caught pneumonia”.

subparts.label: b
subparts.text:
“…although it did not originate lSI, India is often considered to have been the
paradigmatic case of this development strategy.”

question_text:
How are Modernization theory and Dependency theory positioned as ideological
projects against each other? Explain the intersecting points and contrasting positions
between the two in ideological as well as strategic terms.
